\medskip\noindent{\bf Theorem 2.1.} {\it Let $X$ be a compact space. Then $X$ is bounded.}

\noindent{\it Proof.} Cover $X$ by balls. \qed

\noindent\textbf{Definition.} A space is nice when it is compact.
